## Decisions

- **No email columns in messages or message_recipients tables**: Follows privacy architecture: email addresses are resolved strictly on-demand by service-role send-role-mail function.
- **Use security definer helper functions to break RLS recursion**: Avoids infinite recursion errors when messages and message_recipients policies reference each other.
